options.concept: A barrack doorway divides a carefully polished interior floor from the wet boot prints of an arrival; the portrait-referenced person pauses at the threshold holding a mop while looking between the advancing footprints and immaculate passage. Architectural deadpan satire carried by a cleaning task that the room defeats.

A portrait-referenced person and a second performer carry a small timber sentry booth sideways through a barrack passage, its rigid roof narrowly caught under the door lintel; the doorway makes the imposed task visibly absurd. Environmental deadpan satire carried by a real collision of two architectural scales.

A barrack corridor has a waist-high barrier placed beside an open doorway; the portrait-referenced person has to pass through the adjoining empty room to continue down the same corridor, carrying a metal meal tray. Environmental deadpan satire carried by a visible useless detour.

comparative_reason: All three connect a person to an environment that makes an ordinary duty absurd. Threshold is intimate but may collapse into ordinary cleaning. Portable guardhouse makes the obstructing owner and boundary concrete but needs two bodies and a clearly visible lintel contact. Corridor detour is quiet architectural irony but may require too much route inference. Random choice is binding for this independent baseline.
